description: Figure 8 illustrates the relationship between recent sequence ratio (expressed as a percentage) and both perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is a dual axis; the left y-axis is labeled “Perplexity” and uses a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are two lines plotted: a purple line with circular markers representing perplexity, and a teal line with square markers representing GPU memory ratio. The purple perplexity line begins at approximately 4.65 at 0% recent sequence ratio, decreases to approximately 4.35 at 20%, and then increases to approximately 4.45 at 100%. The teal GPU memory ratio line begins at approximately 95% at 0% recent sequence ratio, decreases to approximately 60% at 20%, and then increases to approximately 70% at 100%.
